messages.subject: Executive search introduction | Thailand and ASEAN country leadership
messages.body:
Dear Monroe Consulting Thailand Team,

I am introducing my profile for executive searches across Thailand and ASEAN where country leadership, external affairs, ESG or government relations are central to business performance.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My career spans multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations, with current responsibility for government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy.

I bring operating-side credibility from a major industrial business rather than advisory exposure alone. My recent work includes large-scale renewable-energy stakeholder coordination, carbon-data governance and multi-agency regulatory execution.

I would value consideration for Country Director, Country Representative, Corporate Affairs, External Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships and Chief of Staff mandates. I have attached a Monroe Thailand-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
